items.title: Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1957-04-20
items.q: I had Buddy Pitti working for them when I couldn't, I put him in the other hall

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. So, once, how long did it take you to get established, you know, to get pretty well-known in New Orleans with your own band?

Well, I'd say about two months time I was gone. About two months you were, you had it, huh? and later then I found out the guys were making so much money off of me and I chartered two haul on late days. stuff

you know, before I left. You, you said? Economy Hall and Cooperative Hall. What? I, I tied them up for a whole year, you see. I rent both halls and I promote. Is that so? Yeah, I had Buddy Pitti working for them when I couldn't, I put him in the other hall and couldn't get in my place with the old guy.
